correctness.rationale: For a character of Hamming weight j, exact weight-one and weight-two character sums T_j=(q-1)n-qj and U_j=[T_j²-(q-2)T_j-n(q-1)]/2 yield the complete multiplier -3^p+(1-3^p)T_j+(2^p-3^p)U_j. For every 0<p<1 it is strictly concave in T_j, with vertex (q-2)/2-(3^p-1)/(3^p-2^p); the latter ratio lies strictly between 2 and 3, giving one arithmetic critical index k=floor(((q-1)n+3)/q). The four-coordinate restriction has a positive multiplier q-1 at p=1, while at p→0 all nontrivial eigenvalues tend to -1. The finite-metric negative-type interval/strictness theorem, continuity, and unique maximizing layer provide the unique sharp zero and its nullity. Uniform first-order expansions establish both one-parameter limits. Standalone check.py passed direct character enumeration in 12 instances and tested 144 analytic parameter cases. Finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The three-cap operation is the smallest nontrivial bounded compression of a Hamming product metric for which the failure of Hilbert negative type can be isolated at a harmonic layer. The exact sharp snowflake exponent, nonbinary arithmetic critical degree, large endpoint nullity, and independent n-growth / q-growth limits quantify how support geometry changes Euclidean embeddability. They give natural complete classification of an infinite family, not a single arbitrary invariant or numerical table.
